cases.name: Johnnie Etta Williams Starnes
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She attended Summertown Elementary School and Swainsboro High School. Johnnie was full of life and a dedicated mother, grandmother, sister, aunt, and friend. Johnnie was a CNA at PruittHealth for 23 years and accepted Christ as her Lord and Savior at Full Deliverance Church of Jesus in Swainsboro."
